name: 3000-FREEZE-ACCOUNT
description: This paragraph handles the freezing of an account in the context of fraud detection by updating account status and performing necessary system calls.

algorithm.details: Sets the account's status to 'frozen' using a variable move operation.
Executes system or database-specific operations through COBOL exec-blocks.

sideEffects.description: Updates account information in the database to mark the account as frozen.
